# Final companion observability correction

Prospective, constructed-data-only correction before registration. Preserve the
held-v2 producer map, author 31-test receipt and all peer evidence unchanged. No
scientific specification, parser, numerical kernel, source reader, registration
allocator, store, supervisor or public evaluation projector changes are proposed.

The seven companion envelopes have this complete inventory:

| Companion | Enclosing measured stage | Current access gap | Current usage gap |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| label-routes.json | allocation | Only store-default execution scope; actor, stage, positions and zero counters are absent. | Empty map. |
| development-targets.json | development | Custodian actor, roles, positions and known row counters exist; explicit stage is absent. | Empty map. |
| rank-summary.json | rank_freeze | Actor, stage, positions and zero target counters already exist. | Empty map. |
| calibration-vault.json | reserved | Custodian actor, roles, positions and known row counters exist; explicit stage is absent. | Empty map. |
| evaluation-vault.json | reserved | Same. | Empty map. |
| secondary-membership.json | reserved | Same. | Empty map. |
| completeness.json | reserved | Same. | Empty map. |

All eight **stage** envelopes already contain their measured stage observation and
explicit actor/stage/counter view. The final public evaluation report has its
existing aggregate usage/access schema; the launcher separately discloses its
post-terminal private receipt decoding. Neither is a missing companion case.

Use one closed, source-free companion usage descriptor:

```
schema: lupine.discovery.mpea.companion_usage.v1
enclosing_stage: allocation | development | rank_freeze | reserved
measurement_scope: included_in_enclosing_stage_entry_to_prepublication_observation
independent_artifact_measurement: false
artifact_wall_seconds: null
artifact_cpu_seconds: null
artifact_peak_rss_bytes: null
artifact_measurement_status: NOT_SEPARATELY_MEASURED
stage_observation_may_be_unavailable: true
```

This names the measured stage without a circular reference to its later seal. Its
meaning is limited: companion construction and publication occur inside that
stage's observer window; there is no separately measured artifact duration or
peak, and stage measurement may fail and be explicitly unavailable. Actual stage
observations keep the existing lifetime/boundary RSS scope and unknown values.
The descriptor is bound by content and excluded by the unchanged store's usage
rule from scientific identity. It does not invent a numeric zero or a new peak.

`AllocationUsageStore.write_artifact` will accept only the allocator's fixed
label-route artifact name/schema, reject caller-supplied access/usage overrides,
and delegate with the exact allocation actor/stage/positions and three-role zero
counter view. Production registration remains unchanged. Constructed original
route writers will use this same view. Reproduction continues importing original
allocation and route bytes unchanged, including their original usage descriptor;
the new attempt's import observation remains separate.

The existing target companion access builder will add its unambiguous stage:
development for the development-only role set; reserved for the two reserved
roles. Its known row-bundle counts and authorization remain unchanged. The public
rank summary retains its closed existing zero-target projection access view.

The captured evidence-graph verifier will compare each companion's entire access
view and usage descriptor with the exact expected view, including native types,
execution scope and all role counts. Route access is checked before development
decode; development evidence before fitting; rank summary before reserved decode;
reserved companions before calibration/evaluation consumers; and every reached
companion before final publication and in the parent's post-terminal audit.
These are consistency gates over original inputs, not new statistical checks.

Focused validation will cover all seven persisted companions, missing/extra or
mutated access/usage fields, bool/int distinctions and before-consumer refusals;
verify original allocation/route byte preservation on reproduction; and check the
usage descriptor remains outside scientific preimages. The unchanged full author
paths will be exercised in root's final main-tree suite. The held-v2 31-test run
remains historical evidence, rather than being relabeled as this correction's run.
